name: add-feature
description: Plan, build and verify a new feature in Dead Letter Office

steps.prompt:
Read-only. Investigate where '{{feature_name}}' fits in this project: {{feature_description}}

Review core.js, app.js, index.html and .kiro/steering/*.md. List the files to change, the requirement to add to .kiro/specs/dead-letter-office/requirements.md, and any tests needed. Do not edit files.
Run `node tests/test.js` and `node --check app.js`. Fix any failure and report the final status in two sentences.
